hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; git -C "$d" fetch --quiet origin main 2>/dev/null; n=$(git -C "$d" rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then m="This branch is $n commit(s) behind origin/main. Merge origin/main before starting new work (see Starting new work in CLAUDE.md)."; printf '{"systemMessage":"%s","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"%s"}}\n' "$m" "$m"; fi
